<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Seam Design-Review Gate Checklist</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A standing design-review gate that every agentic system must pass. Completed by the reviewer, once per design. The place to find out is in the design review, not in the post-mortem.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-16-seam-design-review-gate</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>15</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>architect</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>The Deterministic/Probabilistic Boundary</b>, <i>The Architect's Discipline</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch16-deterministic-probabilistic-boundary.qmd</code> L138-146 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch16-deterministic-probabilistic-boundary.html#sec-seam-architects-discipline">#sec-seam-architects-discipline</a>
    &middot; Prerequisites: <code>WS-16-seam-placement-canvas</code> (the diagram habit 1 inspects), <code>WS-16-consequential-effect-register</code> (the rows of the habit 2 table)
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    You are the reviewer, not the author. The author stays in the room and supplies evidence; you hold the pen. For this design, answer three questions with a verdict and evidence each: is the line drawn and is every consequential box on the deterministic side; was the gate chosen before the model; and was a direct write token offered, and if accepted, is the reason and compensating control written down. Each habit returns the design on its own. Nothing here is added up or averaged.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Header <span class="ws-block-note">one per design</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:5%"><col style="width:24%"><col style="width:17%"><col style="width:17%"><col style="width:12%"><col style="width:25%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th>Design under review</th><th>Author</th><th>Reviewer</th><th>Date</th><th>Verdict</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody><tr>
        <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
        <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        <td class="fill"><div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div></td>
        <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">APPROVED</span><span class="opt">APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS</span><span class="opt">RETURNED</span></div></td>
      </tr></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Region A &mdash; the three habits <span class="ws-block-note">one row per habit; this is the gate</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:3%"><col style="width:12%"><col style="width:25%"><col style="width:8%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:12%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th>Habit</th><th>What the habit requires</th><th>Verdict</th><th>Evidence</th><th>Consequential effects still on the probabilistic side</th><th>Reviewer</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td class="prior"><b>Draw the line on the diagram</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L143</span></td>
          <td class="prior">Before you write the prompt or the workflow, sketch the system and label which boxes are deterministic and which are probabilistic. Anything consequential on the probabilistic side is a design defect; redraw until consequential side effects sit on the deterministic side, behind a gate.<span class="prior-src">ch16 L143</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">pass</span><span class="opt">fail</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="ws-block-note">Attach the diagram, boxes labeled deterministic or probabilistic.</span></td>
          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span><span class="ws-block-note"><b>Must be empty.</b> A non-empty list returns the design.</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td class="prior"><b>Pick the gate before you pick the model</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L144</span></td>
          <td class="prior">For each consequential effect, name the failure mode you fear and pick the gate cell &mdash; programmatic-internal, judgement-internal, programmatic-external, judgement-external &mdash; that catches it. Then implement the gate. The model choice is downstream.<span class="prior-src">ch16 L144</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">pass</span><span class="opt">fail</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-box"></span><span class="ws-block-note">Evidence, not assertion: a dated decision record, an ADR, a commit order.</span></td>
          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span><span class="ws-block-note"><b>Must be empty.</b> A non-empty list returns the design.</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td class="prior"><b>Refuse the write token</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L145</span></td>
          <td class="prior">When a vendor or a tool offers the agent a credential that allows direct externalization, ask whether the client offers a strong-form alternative. If it does, take it. If it does not, document why you accepted weak-form and what the compensating control is. Never accept the token without making the choice explicit.<span class="prior-src">ch16 L145</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">pass</span><span class="opt">fail</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
          <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-text"></span><span class="f-text"></span><span class="ws-block-note"><b>Must be empty.</b> A non-empty list returns the design.</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Habit 2 &mdash; one row per consequential effect <span class="ws-block-note">carry rows over from WS-16-consequential-effect-register; do not invent new ones here</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:3%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:19%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:10%"><col style="width:26%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th>2a Consequential effect</th><th>2b Failure mode feared (named before the gate)</th><th>2c Gate cell</th><th>2d Gate implemented?</th><th>2e Gate chosen before the model? Chosen but not built is a fail.</th></tr></thead>

          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>built</span></td>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:3%"><col style="width:17%"><col style="width:17%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:21%"><col style="width:22%"></colgroup>
      <thead><tr><th></th><th>3a Was a direct write credential offered? (by a vendor, a tool or the runtime)</th><th>3b Does the client offer a strong-form alternative? <i>not checked</i> is a fail.</th><th>3c Form accepted</th><th>3d If weak-form: why (mandatory)</th><th>3e If weak-form: compensating control (mandatory)</th></tr></thead>

        <td class="fill taller"><span class="f-box"></span></td>
